children: Our Bureau New Delhi: Eternal Ltd, the parent company of food and grocery delivery platforms Zomato and Blinkit, on Wednesday reported a 78% year-on-year increase in September-quarter operating revenue to 24,138 crore, beating Street estimates. Net profit nearly doubled to 125 crore, but missed brokerage estimates, which ranged from 170-270 crore for the quarter.

Revenue growth was driven largely by the rapid expansion of the Gurgaon-based company's quick commerce business, which reported a 79% year-on-year increase in net order value (NOV) to 20,940 crore. In the September quarter, Blinkit continued to aggressively add dark stores to its network and expects to exceed its March 2027 target of 3,000 stores by 500.

By March 2028, it plans to expand its network to 5,000 micro warehouses. Eternal, which is scaling up its consumer businesses, has also announced its entry into the consumer artificial intelligence (AI) segment. Later this year, the company plans to launch Dark AI, an AI assistant designed to enable private conversations. It uses fine-tuned open-weight models hosted on Eternal's infrastructure and offers end-to-end encryption and user-controlled encrypted memory. "Dark is built for power users-founders, researchers, scientists, enterprises and governments-who want to keep their thoughts private, because privacy is essential for competitiveness," Eternal vice chairman Deepinder Goyal said in the quarterly shareholder letter. "On top of privacy, we have fine-tuned our models to give you the absolute best quality of answers we have seen from any LLM (benchmarks will be revealed soon).

Our models are trained to not please you, and tell you what they think is the truth." During an earnings call with analysts, Eternal's CFO, Akshant Goyal, said Dark AI is at an early stage but could require significant investments in computing and infrastructure if scaled up. He said the product would be priced at the higher end of the market when launched publicly, potentially limiting its appeal to a mass audience.

title: Eternal's Q2 Profit Nearly Doubles, Misses Estimates
